args: Write-Host '[1/3] Checking for stale/orphaned Claude processes...' -ForegroundColor Cyan; $killed = 0; Get-CimInstance Win32_Process | Where-Object { $_.Name -like '*claude*.exe' } | ForEach-Object { $p = Get-Process -Id $_.ParentProcessId -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; $age = [math]::Round(((Get-Date) - $_.CreationDate).TotalHours, 1); if (($null -eq $p) -or ($age -ge 4)) { Write-Host ('  -> Terminating stale process (PID ' + $_.ProcessId + ', Age: ' + $age + 'h)...') -ForegroundColor Yellow; Stop-Process -Id $_.ProcessId -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; $killed++ } }; if ($killed -eq 0) { Write-Host '  -> No stale processes found.' -ForegroundColor Green } else { Write-Host ('  -> Cleaned up ' + $killed + ' stale processes.') -ForegroundColor Green }; Write-Host '[2/3] Activating Python virtual environment (.venv)...' -ForegroundColor Cyan; & '${workspaceFolder}/.venv/Scripts/Activate.ps1'; Write-Host '[3/3] Launching Claude Code...' -ForegroundColor Cyan; claude

Write-Host '[1/2] Activating Python virtual environment (.venv)...' -ForegroundColor Cyan; & '${workspaceFolder}/.venv/Scripts/Activate.ps1'; Write-Host '[2/2] Launching Claude Code Router (CCR UI)...' -ForegroundColor Cyan; ccr ui
